svg.title: Direct subtraction gives ∥feedback(h)x −centroid(h)∥F ≤colorScale income(x). By self-consistency each hx is nearest to its feedback. Choose a nearest centroid point b and replace h by b−1h. Identity is then nearest to the centroid, whose distance from identity is at most √ 8 colorScale2 m, using a suitable index and the squared-average inequality. Choose the focus comparison radius δ for error coefficient one, σ = (δ/2)2/(8 colorScale2) and a = δ/(2 colorScale). If m < σ and income is below a, both feedback and centroid lie in the comparison domain. The centroid lies within δ/2 of identity and feedback within δ.
